title: Misere Quotients for Impartial Games
notes: Standard construction and algorithms. Partial quotient Q_n is the misere quotient of all sums of heaps of individual size at most n. Q_33(0.07) has order 638 and |P|=109; whether Q_34(0.07) is infinite is stated as open. MisereSolver verifies a candidate reduced bipartite monoid, returns a least failure, and recalibrates; it terminates when the true quotient is finite and may loop if the quotient is infinite. Finite observation is not a finiteness proof. Transition algebras and mex functions are the established finite summaries.
